success.description: A multicoloured bolt of malevolent energy streaks from your hand. You hit the target for 5 damage, plus damage equal to his current corruption

bane.description: The target loses 1 corruption, burned away by the spell's effect

chaosStar.description: 33+ Suffer 1 wound per point of the target's current corruption

sigmarsComet.description: Turn a number of the target's normal wounds face up equal to his current corruption. When this spell has completely recharged, turn the wounds affected by this spell face down again

conservative.requirements: 6 power, the target must be suffering from 1 or more corruption

success.description: 4 Multicoloured bolts hit the targets for damage equal to their current corruption
As above, but +5 damage to all targets instead

sigmarsComet.description: Each target suffers 1 corruption before this spell resolves

reckless.requirements: 6 power, up to 4 targets within medium range. All targets must be suffering from 1 or more corruption. Special: This action is opposed by the highest Discipline (WP) score amongst all its targets. Add {Dm} to the dice pool for each target beyond the first
